name: Harkin's Reprieve: you wake…
description: Rules 4.6, Harkin's Reprieve: you wake d6 hours later, somewhere the Dark Master chooses or rolls.

results.description: On the black sand of the Gaslake shore, among the offerings that the barges of Harkin's Last Hall did not take.
On a slab in a Silent Fraternity ossuary, as a Silent Mourner stares down at you in silent disapproval.
In a Wickguard cell, charged with something you did not do. Your gear is in the evidence room.
In a Hinterlands farmhouse, tended by strangers who will want something in return.
Beside a guttering campfire with your companions, who swear they saw you die.
Where you fell, hours later. The fight is over, the dark has moved on, and someone has gone through your pockets: you lose one item of the Dark Master's choice.
